  • Method Details

    • evaluate

      UnsplitTransientSolver.Evaluation evaluate(double[][] state, double[] pressure, double[][] closureState, double[] closurePressure, double time, double outletPressure, boolean outletPressureFixed)
      Evaluate six conservative rates and three phase densities at the selected trial time level.
      Parameters:
      state - seven-column conservative state; column six is unchanged isothermal energy
      pressure - cell-centre pressure in Pa at the selected time level used by conservative rates
      closureState - end-of-step conservative state used by volume closure
      closurePressure - end-of-step cell pressure in Pa used by phase densities
      time - selected coefficient-evaluation time in s, also used for end-state closure densities
      outletPressure - fixed outlet-face pressure in Pa, or NaN for a free outlet
      outletPressureFixed - true when the outlet face has a pressure boundary condition
      Returns:
      transactional model evaluation

    • beginLinearization

      default void beginLinearization(double[][] state, double[] pressure)
      Freeze nonsmooth donor, flow-regime and complementarity choices for one Jacobian, including its unperturbed base residual. The solver releases these choices before the line search, even when initialization or a probe fails.
      Parameters:
      state - conservative state at the selected time level
      pressure - pressure in Pa at the selected time level

    • endLinearization

      default void endLinearization()
      Release any choices frozen by beginLinearization(double[][], double[]), including partially initialized choices if that call failed. Implementations must permit cleanup after a failed initialization.

    • updateActiveSet

      default boolean updateActiveSet(double[][] state, double[] pressure)
      Refresh nonsmooth choices at the initial iterate or after an accepted Newton update. After a reported change the solver reevaluates the residual before calling this method again at the same iterate. Calls receive defensive state copies and occur outside a frozen linearization.
      Parameters:
      state - updated conservative state at the selected time level
      pressure - updated pressure in Pa at the selected time level
      Returns:
      true when an active choice changed and the residual must be reevaluated
